card.description: The silent chronicler of the apocalypse, a scribe wandering the ruins of antediluvian civilizations. He bridges the gap between human understanding and the incomprehensible machinery of the Watchers, bearing the weight of forbidden knowledge. A fusion of ancient asceticism and advanced recording technology.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Lean, ascetic build, conveying endurance and agility. Skin is deep earth-tone, weathered by cosmic winds and harsh UV exposure.
**Face/Sensors:** Eyes shielded by complex, brass-rimmed goggles with multi-spectral crystalline lenses. Lower face wrapped in a nomadic shemagh interwoven with golden conductive filaments.

**Clothing/Armor:** Wears a fusion of Bedouin-style robes and a technician's harness. The fabric is heavy, dust-colored linen, reinforced with patches of flexible solar-weave and oxidized copper plating.

**Key Features:** A backpack-mounted sensor array that resembles a traditional woven basket but hums with anti-gravity energy. Hands are wrapped in bandages, fingers tipped with metallic interface thimbles.
evolution: Phase 1 (Default): The Witness. Clad in full travel gear, equipped to record data in hazardous, high-radiation ancient environments.
props: Item: Chronicle Tablet - A slab of dark obsidian glass framed in eroded bronze, displaying shifting holographic cuneiform.
Item: Sensor Staff - A walking stick made of petrified wood topped with a rotating, geometric sensor cluster.
card.prompt_block: A photorealistic medium shot of the Narrator, an ancient-tech scribe standing amidst obsidian ruins. He wears heavy, dust-colored linen robes intricately embroidered with copper circuitry patterns. His face is partially obscured by a tactical shemagh, and he wears brass-rimmed goggles with glowing crystalline lenses. A heavy, primitive-looking sensor backpack is strapped to his shoulders. He holds a dark glass tablet displaying holographic cuneiform data. The lighting is dramatic, high-contrast sunset striking the metallic threads in his clothing. Texture of worn fabric and oxidized metal is palpable.
